title: Scrolling Credits
extensionText: Scrolling Credits on Streamer.bot Extensions Wiki

options.name: ignoreThisDefaultWebsocket
options.label: Using Default WebSocket settings
options.description: Uncheck if you are not using the default Streamer.bot WebSocket settings: ws://127.0.0.1:8080/

options.name: websocketSettings
options.label: WebSocket Settings
options.description: Change these settings if your Streamer.bot WebSocket server are not using default settings

options.name: host
options.label: Host
options.description: The host of the Streamer.bot Websocket server to connect to

options.name: port
options.label: Port
options.description: The port number of the Streamer.bot Websocket server to connect to

options.name: endpoint
options.label: Endpoint
options.description: The endpoint of the Streamer.bot Websocket server to connect to

options.name: secure
options.label: Secure?
options.description: Required when using a tunnel to connect to a remote host. Usually you'll set port to 443 when using this

options.name: password
options.label: Websocket Password
options.description: Password for your Streamer.bot Websocket server if enforcing authentication

options.name: ignoreThisIterations
options.label: Infinite Iterations?
options.description: Choose whether or not you want to display the broadcaster in the credits

options.name: iterations
options.label: Iterations
options.description: Number of times to play credits

options.name: removeBroadcaster
options.label: Exclude broadcaster and bot from credits?
options.description: Choose whether or not you want to display the broadcaster and bot accounts in the credits

options.name: excludeUsers
options.label: Exclude User Group
options.description: Choose a User Group to exclude from credits

options.name: groupName
options.label: Exclude user group?
options.description: Name a user group and these users will not appear in credits. You can use multiple group and separate with a pipe |

options.name: introImageUrl
options.label: Intro Image URL
options.description: Display an image at the beginning of the credits

options.name: introText
options.label: Intro Text
options.description: Display some text at the beginning of the credits

options.name: introImageFirst
options.label: Show intro image above intro text?

options.name: outroImageUrl
options.label: Outro Image URL
options.description: Display an image at the end of the credits

options.name: outroText
options.label: Outro Text
options.description: Display some text at the end of the credits

options.name: outroImageFirst
options.label: Show outro image above outro text?

options.name: scrollingSpeedPercent
options.label: Scrolling Speed (in percent)
options.description: How fast the credits will scroll. Default: 100%

options.name: groupAlternateSpeed
options.label: Alternate way of handling Credits Speed

options.name: creditsDuration
options.label: Credits Duration (in seconds)
options.description: Choose how long you want the length of the credits to be.

options.name: pixelSpeed
options.label: Pixel Speed
options.description: (Advanced) Adjust the speed of the credits

options.name: testCredits
options.label: Play Test Credits
options.description: Use when testing and you want to scroll all possible types of credits
